definitions.explanation: Surgical procedures performed to improve one's appearance, as opposed to reconstructive surgery performed for medical necessity.

examples.japanese: {美容整形|びようせいけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
{美容整形|びようせいけい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{興味|きょうみ}→興味：01316_kyoumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More and more young people are interested in cosmetic surgery.

examples.japanese: {美容整形|びようせいけい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{慎重|しんちょう}→慎重：03264_shinchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}→検討：02710_kentou⟧すべきだ。
examples.english: There are risks to cosmetic surgery, so it should be considered carefully.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{美容|びよう}→美容：00014_biyou⟧ (beauty, cosmetic) + ⟦{整形|せいけい}→整形：09493_seikei⟧ (reshaping, plastic surgery). Often shortened to just ⟦{整形|せいけい}→整形：09493_seikei⟧ in casual conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美容整形|びようせいけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to have cosmetic surgery
- {美容整形|びようせいけい}{外科|げか}: cosmetic surgery clinic
- {美容整形|びようせいけい}⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧: cosmetic surgery operation
- プチ⟦{整形|せいけい}→整形：09493_seikei⟧: minor cosmetic procedure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{整形|せいけい}→整形：09493_seikei⟧: plastic surgery — the abbreviated form; can also mean orthopedic surgery in medical contexts (⟦{整形外科|せいけいげか}→整形外科：22066_seikeigeka⟧)
- {形成外科|けいせいげか}: reconstructive surgery — surgery to restore function or normal appearance after injury or birth defects
- {美容外科|びようげか}: cosmetic surgery department — the medical specialty name
